The difference is dynamic.

The body was made for movement.

Designed with our Dynamic Matrix Technology, Artelon restores stability and allows motion for optimal soft tissue integration.
CONTACT US

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: RESOURCES

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
More than a suture repair.

Innovation that becomes a part of you.

Traditional repairs force a trade-off, stability at the cost of motion, or flexibility at the cost of strength. Artelon eliminates that compromise. Powered by our Dynamic Matrix Technology, every Artelon solution is engineered to reinforce repairs and provide strength without significantly impacting stiffness.3 It is designed to share load5 with native tissue3 and gradually integrates over 4-6 years1,2 to become part of the body’s own structure. Because true healing is more than a repair and should be as dynamic as the body it’s supporting.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: This animation is courtesy of Taggart Gauvain, MD.

Dynamically stable

Engineered for the way you move.

Artelon has been shown to increase the strength of a repair without significantly impacting the tissue stiffness.3 Designed to mimic the body’s own elasticity4, Artelon strengthens repairs while preserving motion3, maintaining at least 90% of its original strength in the first year to protect repairs through critical healing phases.2,9

text_copy_copy_copy.text:
Dynamically integrative.

Technology today. Tissue tomorrow.

Artelon doesn’t just support the repair. It integrates with the body. Our permeable, synthetic scaffold is designed to integrate with the body’s connective tissue over 4 –6 years1,2,6, encouraging natural tissue in growth and load sharing which may support regenerative biological signaling.7,8 This load-sharing design helps the body support stronger tissue with long term bio-integration.

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: Light micrograph of Rabbit (A) and Porcine (B) ACL. Stain at 2 years demonstrates Artelon fibers (black arrows) with surrounding connective tissue containing organized vascular channels (red arrows). (B) Type I collagen fibers within the connective tissue between the Artelon fibers (white).1
SEM images of FlexBand Matrix and hTenocytes proliferation at 8 days10 (shown in neon green).

Dynamically designed.

For the skill of surgeons and the strength of patients.

Artelon doesn’t just include implants designed to support patients’ repairs, but also instrumentation for the surgeon hands making it possible. With its high-strength, fray-resistant, trimmable material and anchors with instrumentation designed to be used with the FlexBand, the Artelon kits provide surgical efficiency and reproducibility. Artelon is more than a material. The entire portfolio provides options to strengthen the repairs that start in your hands and support patients’ lives.

Applications

Artelon FlexBand, FlexPatch, and FlexBand Plus are intended for reinforcement of soft tissues to support the:

• Rotator cuff
  • Patellar tendon
  • Achilles tendon

• Biceps tendon
  • Quadriceps tendon
  • Medial collateral ligament

• Lateral collateral ligament
  • Spring ligament
  • Deltoid ligament

• Ulnar collateral ligament
  • Other tendons
  • Other extra-articular ligaments

Product offerings

The Artelon portfolio consists of Dynamic Matrix products, FlexBand, FlexBand Plus and FlexPatch, and kitted anchor systems which incorporate FlexBand with complete sets of tools and implants in a single-use, sterile blister. There are 9 FlexBand sizes, 7 FlexBand Plus sizes, 3 FlexPatch sizes and 6 kitted anchor systems.

FlexBand Twist is our flagship system with twist-in anchor locking and a MOD cube for interoperative anchor adaptability.
FlexBand Solo is a comprehensive procedure kit with tap-in fixation for single ligament augmentation.

standaloneimage_copy.alt: Artelon FlexBand Multi and Multi XL

text_copy_copy_copy_.text: FlexBand Multi and Multi XL are comprehensive procedure kits with tap-in fixation and longer FlexBand for multiple ligament augmentation.
FlexBand Fix is a scaled down procedure kit with tap-in fixation for single ligament augmentation.

Instrumentation

The FlexBand Twist anchor system comes with a twist in, PEEK anchor pre-loaded on the driver with FlexBand (0.5×12cm or 0.5×30cm), Mod Cube with additional anchors, cannulated drill bit, drill guide and K-wires.
